description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a pivotal leadership opportunity to oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader with a passion for creating a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff. You will be instrumental in driving strategic initiatives, fostering a culture of excellence, and maintaining strong community relations. This role offers the chance to make a significant impact on the lives of residents and the success of the facility.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage operations, finance, and staff effectively
Commitment to delivering high-quality patient care and resident satisfaction
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, commensurate with experience.
